prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write strict TypeScript module solution.ts and export the named function.
Required API: export function idempotencyBatchTrace(keys: readonly string[], amounts: readonly number[]): number[] | null
Behavior: Process aligned idempotency keys and signed amounts in arrival order. Apply only the first amount for each key and emit the cumulative total after every arrival. Reject unequal lengths or an empty key; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: keys [a,b,a,c] and amounts [5,2,99,-1] return [5,7,7,6].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

known_bad.label: reapplies-duplicate-keys

reference.code: export function idempotencyBatchTrace(keys:readonly string[],amounts:readonly number[]):number[]|null{if(keys.length!==amounts.length)return null;const seen=new Set<string>(),out:number[]=[];let total=0;for(let i=0;i<keys.length;i++){if(keys[i]==='')return null;if(!seen.has(keys[i])){seen.add(keys[i]);total+=amounts[i]}out.push(total)}return out}
reference.label: author-reference
